ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 90% high-intensity white across the visible ventral surface and 10% low-intensity black concentrated at the median notch, trailing edge, and discrete focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white across both lobes. Low-intensity black geometric region centered at the median notch. Multiple discrete, low-intensity circular and semi-circular clusters (blobs) distributed in the lower-medial region and mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed across the continuous trailing edge, with more pronounced pixel-amplitude variations (valleys) on the distal sections of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast circular rings: one large ring in the lower-central region and two smaller clusters in the mid-right lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) detected on the right lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized low-intensity pigmentation clusters at the distal tips of both lobes and a distinct dark vertical line extending from the mid-right lobe toward the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'donut-shaped' or ring-like pigmentation mark located centrally on the lower ventral surface near the base of the fluke.
